claims.question: q3
claims.claim: An illustrative model says $3M-$15M annual enterprise contracts cover an FDE 2.5x to 6x, mid-market deals cover 0.7x to 1.9x, and deals under $500K cover well under half an FDE's cost.
claims.quote:
• **Large enterprise deals cover the cost with room to spare.** Contracts of $3M to $15M a year, in the model, cover an FDE 2.5x to 6x.

• **Mid-market is knife-edge.** Between 0.7x and 1.9x. Some deals pay, some don’t.

• **Small deals lose money.** Under $500K a year, the model has an FDE covering well under half their cost.

claims.question: q1
claims.claim: Palantir's Q1 2026 filing showed revenue of about $1.63B, up 85% year on year; US commercial revenue of $595M, up 133%; adjusted operating margin of 60%; and gross profit of about $1.42B, roughly 87% of revenue by the author's arithmetic.
claims.quote:
• **Revenue:** about $1.63 billion, up 85% year on year.

• **US commercial revenue:** $595 million, up 133%.

• **Adjusted operating margin:** 60%.

• **Gross profit:** about $1.42 billion. By my own arithmetic that is roughly 87% of revenue.
